overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Assistant Town Manager was never a Group member, so no certification was required, and the draft minutes were corrected before approval.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Assistant Town Manager, listed as a member in draft September 18 minutes, lacked a required Open Meeting Law certification; alternatively, the minutes were inaccurate.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Assistant Town Manager was not required to submit an Open Meeting Law certification.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the draft September 18 minutes were inaccurate because they listed the Assistant Town Manager as a Group member.
allegations.key_passage: Since the September 18 meeting minutes Mr. Morgan alleges were inaccurate were in draft form and have now been corrected to make clear that the Assistant Town Manager was not a Group member, we do not find that the Group violated the Open Meeting Law.
